messages.攻撃加重値7・3コインすべて破壊不能の憤怒斬撃で、羅生と火傷・出血・呼吸を乗せて: A heavy-cost multi-target Wrath Slash E.G.O with 7 Attack Weight and 3 all-Unbreakable Coins that stacks Entangled Life with Burn, Bleed, and Poise to wipe out enemies at once.
messages.羅生: 攻撃後に羅生1を得て、与えたスキルダメージ1につき増える(最大999)。: **Entangled Life [羅生]**: She gains 1 Entangled Life after the attack, plus more per skill damage dealt, up to 999. At the start of Coin Ⅲ, she spends all of it for +1% damage per 5, up to 100% (198% at Threadspin Ⅳ). With a single target, the effect is ×1.5 (×2 at Threadspin Ⅳ). In other words, it is stronger from the second use on.
messages.火傷・出血の参照(解析Ⅲ): 全対象の火傷+出血の威力10につきダメージ量+1%: **Using Burn and Bleed (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: +1% damage per 10 combined Burn and Bleed Potency on all targets, up to 30% (50% at Threadspin Ⅳ), and +1 Coin Power per 10 Count, up to 3 (5 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.呼吸の獲得: 攻撃前に最大共鳴数だけ呼吸を得る(最大7)。解析Ⅲから呼吸回数も増: **Gaining Poise**: Before attacking, gains Poise equal to the highest Resonance, up to 7. From Threadspin Ⅲ, Poise Count also increases.
messages.多様な付与: Ⅰコインは火傷、Ⅱコインは出血を付与し、Ⅲコインはクリティカルダメ: **Varied infliction**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Burn, Coin Ⅱ inflicts Bleed, and Coin Ⅲ gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.パッシブ「三途」: 攻撃スキル終了時に敵が混乱か死亡していれば、次のターンにクリ: **Passive — Sanzu [三途]**: If an enemy is staggered or dead at the end of an attack skill, she gains 1 Crit DMG Up next turn, 3 times per turn.
messages.必要資源は憤怒4・色欲4・傲慢4の計12個。通常戦闘の殲滅や、鏡ダンジョンなどの: It requires 12 resources: 4 Wrath, 4 Lust, and 4 Pride. Use it to clear regular battles or in deep runs such as the Mirror Dungeon.
messages.羅生を自力で稼げる人格と組み、1回目から羅生を乗せる。: Pair it with Identities who can earn Entangled Life themselves so it carries Entangled Life from the first use.
messages.使用後の3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10ずつ減るので、精神力の管理が要る。: For 3 turns after use, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End, so SP management is required.
messages.「4本目のマッチの火」を使用済みで、これが4つ目のスキルに当たるなら、そのパッシ: If 4th Match Flame has already been used and this lands as the fourth skill, that passive's extra effects for Wrath skills and E.G.O skills likely apply.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、束縛1、火傷・出血に応じた強化、攻撃対象が1名のときの羅: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and adds 1 Bind, the Burn- and Bleed-based bonuses, and the Entangled Life amplification for a single target.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力+5になり、羅生を含む各強化の上限が伸びる。: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +5, and the caps on each bonus, including Entangled Life, rise.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 天殺で対象を倒すと与えたダメージ分の羅生を得られ、火傷・出血・呼: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Defeating a target with Tiansha grants Entangled Life equal to the damage dealt; she uses Burn, Bleed, and Poise and supplies Wrath, Pride, and Lust resources.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルで資源を賄え、呼吸を溜める: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: Her Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills cover the resources, and she has many skills that build Poise.
